_doc: v3 settings for the cargotruck (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from cargotruck_prep.json (work dir cargotruck_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/cargotruck_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: cargotruck

source.title: SciFi Vehicle Set 2 - Medium Trucks and Buses - 6mm (Truck Scania35p)
source.author: Shiaic3D
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 5, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. RIGHTS: Shiaic3D, SciFi Vehicle Set 2 (Printables 108619), labelled CC BY 4.0; a remix of untraced originals, the shape after a real brand design; rights unverified; Lee accepted the risk on 2026-10-31. The fit is level (`no_icp` in cargotruck_veh.json); the kit is the v1 `scania_sub.stl` (the subdivided `BT-v_Truck-Scania35p-6mm.stl`). WHEELED: tractor and trailer in one fused hull, 5 axles (10 wheels `wheel_l0`..`wheel_r4`, OWN GEOMETRY, `make_wheel`, on axles fitted to the kit's wheel arches; the kit's wheel faces were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the derivative); the front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. The container with its red mark is part of the original model; the kit's trailer is a plain box, so no part-level change. The kit's grille carries the embossed brand name "SCANIA" (a real trademark): the vertices of the lettering are pressed flat onto the grille panel (`flatten` in cargotruck_prep.json, `veh_prep.py`); the shape is kept, the mark is gone. No turret or gun. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees.
